claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament is scheduled for April 9–12.
Round 1 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Thursday, April 9.
Prime Video airs early coverage of Round 1 from 1–3 p.m. ET on Thursday, April 9.
ESPN airs Round 1 TV coverage from 3–7:30 p.m. ET on Thursday, April 9.
ESPN2 airs Round 1 encore from 8–11 p.m. ET on Thursday, April 9.
Round 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Friday, April 10.
Prime Video airs early coverage of Round 2 from 1–3 p.m. ET on Friday, April 10.
ESPN airs Round 2 TV coverage from 3–7:30 p.m. ET on Friday, April 10.
ESPN2 airs Round 2 encore from 8–11 p.m. ET on Friday, April 10.
Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Saturday, April 11.
Paramount+ airs early coverage of Round 3 from 12–2 p.m. ET on Saturday, April 11.
CBS airs Round 3 TV coverage from 2–7 p.m. ET on Saturday, April 11.
CBS Sports Network airs Round 3 encore from 8 p.m.–Midnight ET on Saturday, April 11.
Round 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Sunday, April 12.
Paramount+ airs early coverage of Round 4 from 12–2 p.m. ET on Sunday, April 12.
CBS airs Final Round TV coverage from 2–7 p.m. ET on Sunday, April 12.
CBS Sports Network airs Round 4 encore from 8 p.m.–1:30 a.m. ET on Sunday, April 12.
Featured Groups coverage is available on Masters.com/App from 9:15 a.m.–7:30 p.m. ET on Thu/Fri.
Featured Groups coverage is available on Masters.com/App from 10:15 a.m.–7 p.m. ET on Sat/Sun.
Amen Corner coverage is available on Masters.com/App from 10:45 a.m.–6 p.m. ET on Thu-Sun.
